name: com.globaltripx/tripx
title: Global TripX
description: Travel answers from Global TripX: entry checks for 199 countries, weather, packing, safety.

tools.name: ask_tripx
tools.description: Answer a travel question (destination, season, what to pack, entry rules, money, safety, food, airports) using only Global TripX guides, in Korean, English or Japanese. Returns a short answer plus the source pages. Covers 199 countries entry checks and 43,000+ places. Use it for trips from or to Korea and Japan especially.

lang.description: Answer language: ko, en or ja (default: guessed from the question)

tools.name: search_tripx_guides
tools.description: Search Global TripX travel guides and tools (destination hubs, trip checklists, weather by month, safety numbers, food, holiday planner, airport tips). Returns titles, one-line summaries and links.

query.description: What to look for, any language (e.g. "Sapporo December packing", "오사카 아이랑", "台湾 SIM")

lang.description: Language of the guides to search: ko, en or ja (default: guessed from the query)

tools.name: country_entry_check
tools.description: Get the Global TripX before-departure page for a country (entry/visa notes, travel advisories, health notes from Korean public data). Give a country name in any language.

country.description: Destination country name in any language (e.g. "Vietnam", "베트남", "ベトナム")

lang.description: Language of the page: ko, en or ja (default: guessed from the country name). The 199-country check page is fullest in ko.
